name: Wild Country Environmental Fund grants
summary: Small grants to registered Australian charities for protecting wild places, flora and fauna, from habitat restoration and weed control to wildlife rehabilitation and seed conservation.

calls.label: Financial year 2027 grants
calls.note: The funder says this year's grants are fully expended.

status.quote: Our grants for the 2027 Financial Year will exceed $50,000 and are now fully expended.

applicant_types.quote: We distribute funds throughout the year to registered Australian charities with DRG1 status.

geography.quote: We provide funding to support the protection of the wild places, flora and fauna of Australia.

access.quote: We encourage applications from registered charities small or large.

amount.quote: We distribute $12,500 a quarter and our individual grants are between $1,000 and $5,000 per project.
